state.objective: Can is a language for AI coding agents; human familiarity is not an optimization target. Correctness and reliable edits outrank total tokens per successful task, a secondary measured goal. There are zero external users or old-source compatibility obligations. Generated TypeScript uses equivalent native JavaScript/Bun operations and only needed contract adapters. Select a design direction for an implementation plan, not a claim that it is implemented.
state.error_evidence: Current source requires error 1000000 payment_declined(str reason), duplicated in an active/retired registry. Graph, checker and runtime reject overlapping application numbers across owners, including a foreign retired number. Yet matching, bounds and assertion equality use qualified declaration plus concrete generic arguments. Terminal JSON contains both numeric id and full typeIdentity with redacted payload. A repository consumer audit found no requirement to resolve a naked application integer across locked builds or preserve it across renames. Both alternatives require coordinated loader/lock/checker/emitter/runtime/report/test changes; built-in catalogue numbers may remain internal metadata.
state.error_contract: After authoring in the chosen grammar, unrelated dependencies must compose without coordinated allocations or further source changes. Preserve distinct owners and generic specializations, redaction, reproducible reports, checkout-relocation independence and interpretation of archived reports from two locked builds. Define rename/retirement and canonical owner scope explicitly. Adding unrelated dependencies must not conflate identities. A compact optional number is build-local only with build ID and archived reverse map; no unqualified integer is a nominal type.
state.action_evidence: The current strongest idiom has centralized URL/status/render helpers, shallow raw-form records and explicit result variants. An isolated invoice Can probe passed 18 assertions, but did not exercise HTTP, a live database or DOM; it cannot prove protected effects. Safe URL and target types do not tie a request to an exact endpoint. Wire field/error strings and separately repeated route/method literals can drift without compile errors. Proposed source and manifest alternatives have equal semantics and neither is implemented or agent-benchmarked. Either needs checker/emitter/catalogue and native adapters. Existing static descriptor checks provide precedent, not an existing action implementation.
state.action_contract: Use exact-path POST /invoice/edit with invoice_key query, invoice_form shallow raw strings, 2048-byte limit, and edit_outcome cases saved/invalid/conflict/forbidden/unavailable mapped to actual 200/422/409/403/503 and inner-swap policy. One canonical package-instance/declaration identity links URL builder, method, form, mount and exhaustive response mapping. Checked direct field references preserve wire owner/type; strict decoding handles duplicates/unknown fields. Endpoint identity does not prove authorization, DOM presence, persistence or retry safety. Handler owns authentication/CSRF and protected tenant/revision checks; browser and database tests remain necessary. Server mount must not enter browser builds. Typed path captures, nested rows, components and typed DOM scopes are separate work, not prerequisites for this choice.
state.action_tradeoffs: A source declaration keeps the contract beside ordinary types, adds top-level action grammar/contextual sections and exported static action symbols consumed by catalogue operations; action symbols cannot become arbitrary mutable runtime data. A manifest descriptor adds no Can declaration grammar but introduces a second checked authoring surface, type/case strings resolved as symbols, synthetic package members, collision/privacy/ownership rules and key-aware diagnostics. It must resolve in the owning dependency environment. It generates ordinary URL/post/mount functions with identical static guarantees. Ordinary helpers add no new language mechanism but leave exact endpoint and string drift checks to disciplined centralization and companion tests. Measure creation, rename and diagnostic repair against this factored baseline before making agent-efficiency claims.

application_error_identity.instructions: Which of the two complete application-error authoring and reporting contracts should be selected for the implementation plan, given the audited consumers and required independent composition?

criteria.qualified_text: Adopt error payment_declined(str reason), without an authored application integer or active numeric registry. Canonical owner/declaration plus concrete arguments identify errors; use explicit qualified textual report keys. Renames create a new identity and archived old reports remain tied to their locked build; optional compact IDs require per-build reverse maps. Define textual retirement/reuse policy without duplicating active source allocations.
criteria.owner_number: Adopt error 1000000 payment_declined(str reason) with an owner-local active/retired registry. Independent owners may allocate or retire the same number. Reports identify canonical owner plus local number and concrete generic type, never a naked integer; retain within-owner numerical stability and its retirement policy despite duplicated source/registry allocation.

action_contract_placement.instructions: Which authoring direction should the implementation plan use for the bounded checked action contract, weighing reliable agent edits and mechanism cost without assuming unmeasured token gains?

criteria.source_action: Add a source action declaration adjacent to its Can types, with method/path/query/form/result/body/case sections and exported canonical static symbol. Checked action::url, action::post and action::mount consume that symbol. Implement the shared exact-path/field/response semantics and compare against current helpers; leave captures separately gated.
criteria.checked_manifest: Add a checked actions manifest descriptor referencing owner-relative Can types/cases and synthesizing ordinary save_invoice_url/save_invoice_post/save_invoice_mount calls. Implement the same exact-path/field/response guarantees without a new Can declaration; compare with the factored helper baseline and leave captures independent.
criteria.ordinary_helpers: Retain only ordinary centralized helpers and companion HTTP/browser/database tests for now. Do not implement a checked action declaration or manifest descriptor; accept that exact endpoint identity and loose string drift are not static guarantees and revisit a mechanism only after further measured baseline failures.
